events.text: The body which became the IAB was created with the name Internet Configuration Control Board.
events.subject: self
events.quote: with the name Internet Configuration Control Board in 1979

events.text: The ICCB was reorganized by Dr. Barry Leiner around a series of task forces.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1983 , the ICCB was reorganized by Dr . Barry Leiner

events.text: The re-organized group was named the Internet Activities Board.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The re-organized group was named the Internet Activities Board

events.text: The IAB has set for itself seven principal foci for the period since 1989.
events.subject: self
events.quote: seven principal foci for the period since 1989

events.text: It finally became the Internet Architecture Board, under ISOC.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It finally became the Internet Architecture Board , under ISOC , during January 1992
